fusions.name: Shed Scale
fusions.desc: Tears a scale from your own hide and throws it into the first enemy it meets. It deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Sudden Bristle
fusions.desc: Flares spines in a cone 3 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Plating
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds, and gives you 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Overlapping Ranks
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once into a shield worth 8% of your maximum health per stack. Its effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
